notes: Prism 2.6.1: a call that recorded but came back as an empty note now writes a real note instead of silently ending up blank. The meeting card shows up for the second of two back-to-back meetings, and two calls inside one calendar block no longer overwrite each other. A note you rename keeps the name you gave it. The app no longer freezes for a moment when a call ends. Your audio is never stored. Free.
